actual_Boolean_family: same fixed controller with constant seed, whose arbitrary-seed cancellation is independently checked in check.py
parameter_domain: all deterministic adaptive trees querying only remaining four u coordinates, with stop permitted at every state
symmetry: No symmetry. Identical exact cost pairs are aggregated WITH multiplicities; recurrence T0=1,Td=1+d*T(d-1)^2.
arithmetic: Independent fast integer Walsh implementation; entropy as exact rational coefficients of log2(2),log2(3); sign by integer-power comparison after denominator clearing, independent of first checker's log intervals.
